title: Word Problems With Extra Information
intro: Teach your student to select information based on the question.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Read the question together, then label what each number describes. Cross out an irrelevant detail only after discussing why it is not needed.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

Question: How many books are there now?

Useful quantities: 7 books already there and 5 books received.

Extra detail: room 8.

7 + 5 = 12

There are 12 books. The room number is not part of that total.

Ask your student

Does the room number tell us how many books there are?

If your student needs help

If the student uses every number, compare a quantity with a label such as a classroom number.
